comment:exclude: Build outputs only. Each `next build` writes a routes-to-modules validator into <distDir>/types and appends that path to `include` above; every past dist dir left one behind, so a stale one still names routes this app no longer has and `tsc --noEmit` fails on a route that was deliberately removed. Typechecking a build artifact proves nothing the source doesn't, so they are excluded rather than pruned by hand.
